parameters.query:
WITH consultation AS (
    INSERT INTO public.patient_consultations (
        patient_id,
        language,
        transcript
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $3,
        $2
    )
    RETURNING
        consultation_id,
        patient_id,
        language,
        transcript,
        consultation_date
)
SELECT
    c.consultation_id,
    c.patient_id,
    c.language,
    c.transcript,
    c.consultation_date,
    p.first_name,
    p.last_name,
    p.date_of_birth
FROM consultation c
JOIN public.patient_identity p
    ON p.patient_id = c.patient_id;

SELECT
    pi.patient_id,
    pi.first_name,
    pi.last_name,
    pi.date_of_birth,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(
            json_build_object(
                'consultation_id', pc.consultation_id,
                'consultation_date', pc.consultation_date
            )
            ORDER BY pc.consultation_date DESC
        ) FILTER (WHERE pc.consultation_id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS consultations
FROM public.patient_identity pi
LEFT JOIN public.patient_consultations pc
    ON pc.patient_id = pi.patient_id
WHERE pi.patient_id = $1
GROUP BY
    pi.patient_id,
    pi.first_name,
    pi.last_name,
    pi.date_of_birth;
